   383	/-- Nonvanishing on every residue-field fibre of `D(f)` survives passage from the
   384	corresponding prime of the original ring to the residue field of a prime of `A_f`.
   385	
   386	The residue-field comparison is an isomorphism because localization induces bijective
   387	residue-field maps.  Keeping this as a private module lemma prevents the rank-one
   388	construction from depending on a false definitional transitivity of datum base change. -/
   389	private theorem fibre_tmul_ne_zero_of_away
   390	    {A Q : Type u} [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup Q] [Module A Q]
   391	    (f : A) (y : Q)
   392	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   393	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   394	        Q ⊗[A] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   395	    (q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away f)) :
   396	    ((1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
   397	      q.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
   398	  let p : PrimeSpectrum A :=
   399	    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) q
   400	  have hfp : f ∉ p.asIdeal := by
   401	    intro hf
   402	    refine q.isPrime.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem q.asIdeal
   403	      (Ideal.mem_comap.mp hf) ?_)
   404	    exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit f
   405	  have hp : ((1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
   406	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
   407	    have h := (TensorProduct.comm A Q p.asIdeal.ResidueField).map_ne_zero_iff.mpr
   408	      (hy p hfp)
   409	    simpa only [TensorProduct.comm_tmul] using h
   410	  have hcom : p.asIdeal =
   411	      q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) := rfl
   412	  let rho : p.asIdeal.ResidueField →ₐ[A] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   413	    Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ p.asIdeal q.asIdeal
   414	      (Algebra.ofId A (Localization.Away f)) hcom
   415	  have hrho : Function.Bijective rho :=
   416	    (RingHom.surjectiveOnStalks_of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers f)
   417	      (Localization.Away f)).residueFieldMap_bijective
   418	        p.asIdeal q.asIdeal hcom
   419	  let e : p.asIdeal.ResidueField ≃ₗ[A] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   420	    LinearEquiv.ofBijective rho.toLinearMap hrho
   421	  have he := (e.rTensor Q).map_ne_zero_iff.mpr hp
   422	  simpa only [LinearEquiv.rTensor_tmul, e, LinearEquiv.ofBijective_apply,
   423	    AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, map_one] using he

   547	localization, cancels the iterated tensor product, and then uses the presentation's
   548	canonical `H⁰` base-change equivalence. -/
   549	theorem sectionsMapTop_datumSectionBaseChange_away_ne_zero
   550	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   551	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   552	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   553	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   554	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   555	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   556	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   557	    (q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away f)) :
   558	    (P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away f)).sectionsMapTop
   559	      q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   560	      (P.datumSectionBaseChange (Localization.Away f) y) ≠ 0 := by
   561	  let B := Localization.Away f
   562	  let K := q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   563	  have hiter : ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B]
   564	      ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y) :
   565	      K ⊗[B] (B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   566	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)) ≠ 0 :=
   567	    away_one_tmul_one_tmul_ne_zero f y hy q
   568	  have hyB : ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B]
   569	      (P.h0BaseChange B ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y)) :
   570	      K ⊗[B] Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0) ≠ 0 :=
   571	    P.h0BaseChange_one_tmul_ne_zero B K y hiter
   572	  have hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair (P.datum.baseChange B)).H1 :=
   573	    P.datumPair_h1_baseChange B
   574	  let yB : Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0 :=
   575	    P.h0BaseChange B ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y)
   576	  change (P.datum.baseChange B).sectionsMapTop K
   577	    (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   578	      (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   579	      isTerminalTop (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf yB) ≠ 0
   580	  exact sectionsMapTop_ne_zero_of_one_tmul_ne_zero
   581	    (P.datum.baseChange B) hH1 yB hyB

   583	/-- A rank-one presentation has a tied local-away evaluation generator.
   584	
   585	The rank-one field of `P` makes every residue-field fibre of its `H⁰` module nontrivial.
   586	The projective-module generator lemma therefore supplies a single basic open `D(f)` and
   587	one datum section `y` which stays nonzero on every residue fibre over that open.  The same
   588	`y` is transported to a native global section and its unit-lift through the evaluation
   589	counit; the final conjunct records that counit identity explicitly so the future
   590	`divisorOfRankOne` construction consumes this witness rather than an unrelated section.
   591	-/
   592	theorem exists_baseOpen_evaluation_generator
   593	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   594	    (p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier) :
   595	    ∃ f : P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
   596	      ∃ y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0,
   597	        (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ q.asIdeal →
   598	          (y ⊗ₜ (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   599	            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   600	              q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) ∧
   601	        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
   602	          ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   603	            (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   604	          (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y) = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y := by
   605	  let Q := Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0
   606	  letI : Module.Finite P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_finite
   607	  letI : Module.Projective P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_projective
   608	  have hfr : Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   609	      (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Q) = 1 := by
   610	    rw [← Module.rankAtStalk_eq]
   611	    exact P.h0_rank_one p
   612	  haveI : Nontrivial (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Q) :=
   613	    Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (by rw [hfr]; norm_num)
   614	  haveI : Nontrivial (Q ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   615	    (TensorProduct.comm P.cover.Carrier _ _).toEquiv.symm.nontrivial
   616	  obtain ⟨f, hf, y, hy⟩ :=
   617	    Module.exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective p (Q := Q)
   618	      (by infer_instance)
   619	  refine ⟨f, hf, y, ?_, ?_⟩
   620	  · simpa only [Q] using hy
   621	  · exact P.evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0 y
   622	
   623	/-- The fibrewise-regular local equations cut by a tied local-away datum section.
   624	
   625	The nonvanishing proof is derived by
   626	`sectionsMapTop_datumSectionBaseChange_away_ne_zero`; it is not additional witness data.
   627	Together with `exists_baseOpen_evaluation_generator`, this is the immediate local divisor
   628	consumer on the datum side.  Identifying it with the native evaluation zero locus remains
   629	a separate `O`-module base-change contract. -/
   630	noncomputable def baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations
   631	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   632	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   633	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   634	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   635	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   636	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   637	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   638	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :

   641	    (Localization.Away f) y
   642	    (fun q => P.sectionsMapTop_datumSectionBaseChange_away_ne_zero f y hy q)

   645	cocycle datum. -/

   647	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   648	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   649	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   650	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)

   697	/-- The cocycle datum tied to a genus-degree presentation has class degree `genus C`
   698	after every field-valued coefficient extension.
   699	
   700	The proof follows the presentation itself: restrict `lam` to its etale-cover carrier,
   701	identify that class with `representative`, rewrite it as the datum's relative Picard class,
   702	and read the defining degree condition of `lam`. -/
   703	theorem datum_classDeg_baseChange
   704	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   705	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier L]
   706	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L] :
   707	    classDeg L
   708	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   709	        P.datum.cechPicClass) = genus C := by
   710	  let iota : A →ₐ[k] P.cover.Carrier :=
   711	    (Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k
   712	  let psi : P.cover.Carrier →ₐ[k] L :=
   713	    (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier L).restrictScalars k
   714	  have hcurve :
   715	      relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L =
   716	        (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap psi).left := by
   717	    refine congrArg
   718	      (fun f : overSpec k L ⟶ overSpec k P.cover.Carrier => (C ◁ f).left) ?_
   719	    exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
   720	  have hpresentation :
   721	      picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1 =
   722	        relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   723	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   724	    exact picEtMap_eq_relPicToPicEt_of_affineRepresentative
   725	      C lam.1 P.cover P.representative P.represents.symm
   726	  calc
   727	    classDeg L
   728	        (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   729	          P.datum.cechPicClass) =
   730	      relPicDeg L
   731	        (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)
   732	          (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   733	            P.datum.cechPicClass)) :=
   734	      (relPicDeg_relPicMk L _).symm
   735	    _ = relPicDeg L
   736	        (relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   737	          (relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   738	            P.datum.cechPicClass)) := by
   739	      rw [relPicMap_mk, ← hcurve]
   740	      rfl
   741	    _ = relPicDeg L
   742	        (relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   743	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by
   744	      rw [P.datum_class]
   745	    _ = degAt
   746	        (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   747	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)))
   748	        (Over.overSpecMap psi) :=
   749	      (degAt_relPicToPicEt
   750	        (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))
   751	        (Over.overSpecMap psi)).symm
   752	    _ = degAt (picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1)
   753	        (Over.overSpecMap psi) := by rw [hpresentation]
   754	    _ = degAt lam.1 (Over.overSpecMap psi ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota) :=
   755	      degAt_picEtMap (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1 (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   756	    _ = genus C := lam.2 L (Over.overSpecMap psi ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota)
   757

    83	theorem baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_fibrewiseRegular

   142	  haveI : IsScalarTower P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f) L :=

   144	  haveI : IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L :=
   145	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by

   155	/-! ## The local widened divisor and its immediate consumer -/
   156	
   157	/- The next canonicality edge is expressed first in the localized H⁰ module.  The datum
   158	   section/native comparison needed to transport this unit to local equations is deliberately
   159	   a separate contract. -/
   160	theorem existsUnique_unit_tensorAway_rankOne_generators
   161	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   162	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   163	    (y y' : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   164	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   165	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   166	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   167	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   168	    (hy' : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   169	      (y' ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   170	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   171	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   172	    ∃! v : (Localization.Away f)ˣ,
   173	      ((1 : Localization.Away f) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y') =
   174	        (v : Localization.Away f) •
   175	          ((1 : Localization.Away f) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y) := by
   176	  let B := Localization.Away f
   177	  let Q := Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0
   178	  letI : Module.Finite P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_finite
   179	  letI : Module.Projective P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_projective
   180	  have hrankB : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
   181	      Module.rankAtStalk (B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Q) q = 1 := by
   182	    intro q
   183	    rw [Module.rankAtStalk_baseChange]
   184	    exact P.h0_rank_one (PrimeSpectrum.comap

   225	/-- The Abel value of the local divisor is the restriction of the input Picard datum.  This is

   227	theorem baseOpenRankOneDivisor_abelAff
   228	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   229	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   230	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   231	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   232	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   233	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   234	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   235	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :

   237	      PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f)).restrictScalars k)
   238	        (PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   239	          (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) := by
   240	  let B := Localization.Away f
   241	  let iota : A →ₐ[k] P.cover.Carrier :=
   242	    (Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k
   243	  let psi : P.cover.Carrier →ₐ[k] B :=
   244	    (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier B).restrictScalars k

   247	    P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_picClass f y hy
   248	  have hrel : (relPicMk C (overSpec k B)) F.picClass =
   249	      relPicAlgMap C psi (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   250	    rw [hFclass, P.datum_class, relPicAlgMap_mk]
   251	    have hcurve : Over.Hom.left (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap psi) =
   252	        relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B := by
   253	      refine congrArg (fun f : overSpec k B ⟶ overSpec k P.cover.Carrier => (C ◁ f).left) ?_

   255	    rw [P.datum.cechPicClass_baseChange B, hcurve]

   260	      (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by rw [hrel]

   263	        (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by

   267	      rw [← P.represents, PicEtAff.mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self]

    16	/-!
    17	# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus
    18	
    19	An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
    20	rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
    21	map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
    22	test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
    23	
    24	* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
    25	* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
    26	* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
    27	* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
    28	* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.
    29	
    30	No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
    31	consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
    32	The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
    33	from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies
    34	datum `H^0` with native global sections and proves, by the adjunction triangle identity, that
    35	the evaluation counit sends the canonical unit-lift back to that same section.
    36	-/
    37	
    38	set_option autoImplicit false
    39	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    40	
    41	universe u
    42	
    43	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    44	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    45	
    46	open scoped TensorProduct

    48	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    49	
    50	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    51	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    52	
    53	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    54	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    55	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    56	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    57	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    58	
    59	/-- A rank-one presentation of a genus-degree plus class on an affine test.
    60	
    61	The two equality fields prevent an unrelated cocycle datum or line bundle from serving as a
    62	witness: `representative` presents the input plus class, `datum_class` presents that same
    63	relative Picard class, and `module_iso` identifies the resulting cocycle sheaf with the
    64	underlying base-ring sheaf of `module`. -/
    65	structure PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    66	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    67	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
    68	  representative : descentClasses C cover
    69	  represents :
    70	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
    71	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
    72	  datum_class :
    73	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
    74	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
    75	  module : (relCurve C cover.Carrier).Modules
    76	  module_iso :
    77	    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
    78	      (Over.mk (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier))) module ≅ datum.sheaf
    79	  line_bundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle module
    80	  native_pushforward_base_change :
    81	    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    82	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    83	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
    84	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    85	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
    86	      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app module)
    87	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
    88	  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    89	  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    90	  h0_rank_one :
    91	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
    92	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1

    99	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) (U : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens) :
   100	    Module P.cover.Carrier Γ(P.module, U) :=
   101	  Scheme.moduleKSections

   104	/-- The canonical `H^0` base-change equivalence attached to a rank-one presentation.
   105	
   106	This is derived from `P.h1_vanishing`; it is not an independently chosen witness. -/
   107	noncomputable def h0BaseChange (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   108	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   109	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   110	    B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] (Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) ≃ₗ[B]

   115	/-- The canonical evaluation map attached to a tied local rank-one presentation. -/
   116	noncomputable def evaluation (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
   117	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   118	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj
   119	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   120	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ⟶
   121	      P.module :=
   122	  (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   123	    (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module

   125	/-! ## Native pushforward base change and evaluation coherence -/
   126	
   127	/-- The canonical native pushforward base-change isomorphism supplied by the presentation.
   128	
   129	The isomorphism is not chosen independently: its hom is definitionally
   130	`(canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module`. -/
   131	noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   132	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   133	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   134	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   135	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   136	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   137	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
   138	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   139	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   140	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) := by
   141	  exact @asIso _ _ _ _ ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module)
   142	    (P.native_pushforward_base_change g f' g' sq)

   144	/-- The native pushforward base-change isomorphism for an affine coefficient extension. -/
   145	noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIsoAffine (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   146	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   147	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   148	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   149	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier B)))).obj
   150	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   151	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   152	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   153	        (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))).obj
   154	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).obj P.module) :=
   155	  P.nativeBaseChangeIso
   156	    (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
   157	    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
   158	    (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
   159	    (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))

   161	/-- The source of evaluation identifies canonically with the source of evaluation after any
   162	cartesian base change. -/
   163	noncomputable def evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   164	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   165	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   166	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   167	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   168	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   169	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   170	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⋙
   171	      Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj
   172	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   173	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   174	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback f').obj
   175	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) :=
   176	  ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   177	    Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   178	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
   179	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).app
   180	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   181	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)).symm) ≪≫
   182	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').mapIso (P.nativeBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq)

   184	/-- Under the source identification, evaluation after base change is the pullback of the
   185	presentation's original evaluation counit. -/
   186	theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso_hom_evaluation
   187	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   188	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   189	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   190	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   191	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   192	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   193	    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq).hom ≫
   194	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
   195	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) =
   196	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map P.evaluation := by
   197	  change ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   198	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   199	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
   200	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).inv).app
   201	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   202	            (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)) ≫
   203	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module) ≫
   204	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
   205	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module)) =
   206	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
   207	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   208	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module)
   209	  exact canonicalBaseChangeMap_counit_cancel sq P.module

   211	/-! The affine coefficient-extension spelling of the evaluation/base-change contract.
   212	
   213	This is the consumer-facing specialization for the future zero-locus construction: it keeps
   214	the coefficient ring `B` and `relCurveMap` explicit while retaining the canonical cartesian
   215	square, rather than introducing a second base-change witness. -/
   216	theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIsoAffine_hom_evaluation

   393	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   394	        Q ⊗[A] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   395	    (q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away f)) :
   396	    ((1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
   397	      q.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
   398	  let p : PrimeSpectrum A :=
   399	    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) q
   400	  have hfp : f ∉ p.asIdeal := by
   401	    intro hf
   402	    refine q.isPrime.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem q.asIdeal
   403	      (Ideal.mem_comap.mp hf) ?_)

   405	  have hp : ((1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
   406	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
   407	    have h := (TensorProduct.comm A Q p.asIdeal.ResidueField).map_ne_zero_iff.mpr

   410	  have hcom : p.asIdeal =
   411	      q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) := rfl
   412	  let rho : p.asIdeal.ResidueField →ₐ[A] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=

   414	      (Algebra.ofId A (Localization.Away f)) hcom

   416	    (RingHom.surjectiveOnStalks_of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers f)
   417	      (Localization.Away f)).residueFieldMap_bijective
   418	        p.asIdeal q.asIdeal hcom
   419	  let e : p.asIdeal.ResidueField ≃ₗ[A] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   420	    LinearEquiv.ofBijective rho.toLinearMap hrho

   598	          (y ⊗ₜ (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   599	            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]

     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AtlasFromDivRep
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Category-correct ambient contract for the rank-one Picard route
    11	
    12	The rank-one locus lives in degree `genus C`, not in `pic0`. This module installs the concrete
    13	ambient maps that the later open-locus restriction must consume:
    14	
    15	* `abelDivAffTrans` maps the widened degree-`n` divisor functor to `picDegLayerFunctor C n`;
    16	* `abelDivAffSigma` extends a represented slice map to the ambient big-site presheaf;
    17	* `abelDivAffGenusSigma` specializes the map using the canonical genus representation.
    18	
    19	The future public `PicRankOneOpen` must therefore be a subfunctor of
    20	`picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C)`, and `DivRankOneOpen` must be an open of
    21	`divRepAffGenusScheme C`. Its `rankOneAbel` is the restriction of
    22	`abelDivAffGenusSigma`, after applying the corresponding Sigma extension. No placeholder locus,
    23	inverse, representability witness, or endgame theorem is postulated here.
    24	-/
    25	
    26	set_option autoImplicit false
    27	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    28	
    29	universe u
    30	
    31	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    32	
    33	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    34	
    35	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} {n : ℕ}
    36	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    37	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    38	
    39	noncomputable section
    40	
    41	variable (C n) in
    42	/-- The widened Abel transformation into the intrinsic degree-`n` Picard layer. -/
    43	def abelDivAffTrans : divFunctorAff C n ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (n : ℤ) where
    44	  app T := ↾fun s => ⟨abelDivAff' C n T.unop s, fun K _ _ t => degAt_abelDivAff' s t⟩
    45	  naturality T T' g := by
    46	    ext s
    47	    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    48	    exact (picEtMap_abelDivAff' g.unop s).symm
    49	
    50	@[simp]
    51	lemma abelDivAffTrans_app_coe
    52	    (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) (s : divFamZarAff C n T.unop) :
    53	    ((abelDivAffTrans C n).app T s).1 = abelDivAff' C n T.unop s :=
    54	  rfl
    55	
    56	variable (C n) in
    57	/-- Extend a represented widened Abel map from the slice over `Spec k` to the big site. -/
    58	def abelDivAffSigma {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    59	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) :
    60	    yoneda.obj D.left ⟶
    61	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (n : ℤ)) :=
    62	  rep.toSigmaExtension ≫ Over.sigmaExtensionNat (abelDivAffTrans C n)
    63	
    64	@[simp]
    65	lemma abelDivAffSigma_app_fst {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    66	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) (T : Schemeᵒᵖ)
    67	    (x : T.unop ⟶ D.left) :
    68	    ((abelDivAffSigma C n rep).app T x).1 = x ≫ D.hom :=
    69	  rfl
    70	
    71	@[simp]
    72	lemma abelDivAffSigma_app_coe {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    73	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) (T : Schemeᵒᵖ)
    74	    (x : T.unop ⟶ D.left) :
    75	    ((abelDivAffSigma C n rep).app T x).2.1 =
    76	      abelDivAff' C n (Over.mk (x ≫ D.hom)) (rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk x rfl)) :=
    77	  rfl
    78	
    79	variable (C) in
    80	/-- The ambient genus-degree Abel map on the canonical represented widened divisor scheme.
    81	
    82	This is the map that the future rank-one divisor open must restrict. It is not itself claimed to
    83	be an open immersion. -/
    84	def abelDivAffGenusSigma :
    85	    yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left ⟶
    86	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
    87	  abelDivAffSigma C (genus C) (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C)
    88	
    89	end
    90	
    91	end AlgebraicGeometry

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOnePresentation
     7	import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Subfunctor.Image
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map
    11	
    12	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
    13	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
    14	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
    15	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.
    16	
    17	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
    18	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
    19	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not prove that
    20	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme, and it reserves `DivRankOneOpen` for the
    21	future actual open subscheme of the divisor representer.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    30	
    31	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    32	
    33	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    34	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    35	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    36	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    37	
    38	noncomputable section
    39	
    40	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
    41	
    42	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
    43	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
    44	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
    45	def PicRankOneOpen :
    46	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
    47	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    48	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    49	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    50	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
    51	  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
    52	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
    53	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
    54	      apply Subtype.ext
    55	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
    56	    rw [e]
    57	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)
    58	
    59	/-- The inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` under the affine widened Abel transformation.
    60	
    61	This name deliberately records only a presentation-theoretic preimage.  It is not the future
    62	open subscheme `DivRankOneOpen`. -/
    63	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff :
    64	    Subfunctor (divFunctorAff C (genus C)) :=
    65	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).preimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
    66	
    67	/-- The same presentation preimage on the Yoneda functor of the canonical genus divisor
    68	representer. -/
    69	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter :
    70	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
    71	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).preimage
    72	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
    73	
    74	/-- The affine Abel transformation restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
    75	def rankOneAbelAff :
    76	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor ⟶
    77	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
    78	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).fromPreimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
    79	
    80	/-- Restrict the canonical representation isomorphism to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
    81	def rankOneRepresenterRestriction :
    82	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
    83	      (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor :=
    84	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).fromPreimage
    85	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
    86	
    87	/-- The represented genus Abel map restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
    88	def rankOneAbelRepresented :
    89	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
    90	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
    91	  rankOneRepresenterRestriction pi ≫ rankOneAbelAff pi
    92	
    93	end
    94	
    95	end AlgebraicGeometry

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.ModuleKSheaf
     7	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.Sheaf
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Restricting a scheme module to the base ring
    11	
    12	For a scheme `X` over `Spec k`, this file views an `X.Modules` object as a sheaf of
    13	`k`-modules.  The construction keeps the same section types and restriction maps; only the
    14	scalar action is restricted along `k -> Gamma(X, U)`.  It is the dialect bridge needed to
    15	compare a `Scheme.Modules` line bundle with the fixed-base module sheaves used by the Cech
    16	cohomology engine.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	
    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    24	
    25	namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
    26	
    27	variable {k : Type u} [CommRing k]
    28	
    29	/-- The base-ring module structure on sections of a scheme module. -/
    30	@[reducible] noncomputable def moduleKSections
    31	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules)
    32	    (U : X.left.Opens) : Module k Γ(M, U) :=
    33	  Module.compHom _ (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U)
    34	
    35	attribute [local instance] moduleKSections
    36	
    37	/-- The native structure-sheaf action, with section-notation binders kept explicit. -/
    38	private noncomputable def smulSection
    39	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules)
    40	    (U : X.left.Opens) (r : Γ(X.left, U)) (x : Γ(M, U)) : Γ(M, U) :=
    41	  r • x
    42	
    43	/-- The presheaf underlying a scheme module after restriction of scalars to the base ring. -/
    44	noncomputable def toModuleKPresheafOfModules
    45	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    46	    X.left.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} k where
    47	  obj U := ModuleCat.of k Γ(M, U.unop)
    48	  map {U V} f := ModuleCat.ofHom
    49	    { toFun := fun x => M.presheaf.map f x
    50	      map_add' := fun x y => map_add _ x y
    51	      map_smul' := fun r x =>
    52	        (Scheme.Modules.map_smul M f.unop (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U.unop r) x).trans
    53	          (congrArg
    54	            (fun (s : Γ(X.left, V.unop)) =>
    55	              smulSection X M V.unop s (M.presheaf.map f x))
    56	            (X.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k f r)) }
    57	  map_id U := by
    58	    ext x
    59	    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (f : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj U) =>
    60	      (ConcreteCategory.hom f : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_id U)) x
    61	  map_comp {U V W} f g := by
    62	    ext x
    63	    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (h : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj W) =>
    64	      (ConcreteCategory.hom h : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_comp f g)) x
    65	
    66	/-- The restricted presheaf is a sheaf because its underlying additive presheaf is unchanged. -/
    67	lemma toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf
    68	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    69	    Presheaf.IsSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.left.toTopCat)
    70	      (toModuleKPresheafOfModules X M) := by
    71	  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _ (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{u} k))]
    72	  convert (Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    73	      (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})).mp (Scheme.Modules.isSheaf M) using 1 <;> rfl
    74	
    75	/-- A sheaf of `O_X`-modules, viewed as a sheaf of modules over the base ring. -/
    76	noncomputable def toModuleKSheafOfModules
    77	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    78	    Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.left.toTopCat) (ModuleCat.{u} k) :=
    79	  ⟨toModuleKPresheafOfModules X M, toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf X M⟩
    80	
    81	/-- Restriction maps of the base-ring sheaf are definitionally those of the scheme module. -/
    82	lemma toModuleKSheafOfModules_obj_map_apply
    83	    {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (M : X.left.Modules)
    84	    {V W : X.left.Opens} (h : W ≤ V)
    85	    (x : (toModuleKSheafOfModules X M).obj.obj (op V)) :
    86	    ((toModuleKSheafOfModules X M).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom x =
    87	      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x :=
    88	  rfl
    89	
    90	namespace Modules
    91	
    92	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
    93	
    94	/-- A scheme module which is locally isomorphic to the structure sheaf. -/
    95	def IsLineBundle (M : X.Modules) : Prop :=
    96	  ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧
    97	    Nonempty ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M ≅ SheafOfModules.unit U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
    98	
    99	end Modules
   100	
   101	end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

    12	
    13	```text
    14	g^* f_* M --> f'_* (g')^* M.
    15	```
    16	
    17	The two coherence theorems identify its pullback followed by the counit with the pullback of
    18	the original counit.  Invertibility is deliberately not asserted here: it is a property of the
    19	module and square, not part of the construction of the canonical map.
    20	-/
    21	
    22	set_option autoImplicit false
    23	
    24	universe u
    25	
    26	open CategoryTheory Limits
    27	
    28	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    29	
    30	/-- The canonical Beck--Chevalley mate for pushforward along a cartesian square. -/
    31	noncomputable def canonicalBaseChangeMap
    32	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    33	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    34	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    35	    Scheme.Modules.pushforward f ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback g ⟶
    36	      Scheme.Modules.pullback g' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' :=
    37	  CategoryTheory.mateEquiv
    38	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
    39	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f')
    40	    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    41	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    42	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).hom)
    43	
    44	/-- Pulling back the canonical mate and evaluating recovers its defining pullback telescope. -/
    45	theorem canonicalBaseChangeMap_pullback_counit
    46	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    47	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    48	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (M : X.Modules) :
    49	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app M) ≫
    50	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
    51	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M) =
    52	      ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    53	        Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    54	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).hom).app
    55	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M)) ≫
    56	        (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
    57	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app M) := by
    58	  rw [canonicalBaseChangeMap]
    59	  exact CategoryTheory.mateEquiv_counit _ _ _ M
    60	
    61	/-- After cancelling the pullback telescope, the base-changed counit is the pulled-back
    62	original counit. -/
    63	theorem canonicalBaseChangeMap_counit_cancel
    64	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    65	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    66	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (M : X.Modules) :
    67	    ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    68	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    69	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).inv).app
    70	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M)) ≫
    71	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app M) ≫
    72	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
    73	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M)) =
    74	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
    75	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app M) := by
    76	  erw [canonicalBaseChangeMap_pullback_counit]
    77	  erw [Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
    78	  rfl
    79	
    80	end AlgebraicGeometry

     8	/-!
     9	# The section rank at a chart-locus point
    10	
    11	`Pic0ChartLocusH0One` specializes the chart parameter to the genus and obtains the
    12	unique-effective-representative value `h⁰ = 1`.  This file records the unspecialized
    13	calculation.  If the chart parameter is `n` and the curve has Euler characteristic
    14	`1 - g`, the vanishing witness extracted from `chartLocus` has
    15	
    16	`h⁰ = n + 1 - g`.
    17	
    18	This separates two roles that a coverage argument must not conflate: a large parameter can
    19	force `H¹`-vanishing, while the injective Abel chart needs the genus parameter, where the
    20	same rank formula becomes `h⁰ = 1`.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    30	open TopologicalSpace Opposite
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	open AlgebraicJacobian
    35	
    36	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    37	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    38	
    39	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    40	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    41	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    42	
    43	noncomputable section
    44	
    45	/-- Chart-locus membership at parameter `n` supplies a witness of section rank `n + 1 - g` on a
    46	curve with Euler characteristic `1 - g`.
    47	
    48	The conclusion retains the presentation, divisor-class, degree, and vanishing clauses from
    49	`IsSplitWitness`; consequently it is tied to the given class and cannot be inhabited by an
    50	unrelated trivial divisor. -/
    51	theorem exists_splitting_h0_formula_of_mem_chartLocus
    52	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : picEt C T) (t : T.left)
    53	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor) (n g : ℕ)
    54	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
    55	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
    56	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
    57	    (hlam : degAt lam (Over.testPoint t) = 0)
    58	    (ht : t ∈ chartLocus C m Z lam) :
    59	    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra (Over.testPointField t) L)
    60	        (_ : IsScalarTower k (Over.testPointField t) L)
    61	        (_ : Module.Finite (Over.testPointField t) L)
    62	        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable (Over.testPointField t) L)
    63	        (M : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
    64	        (W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor),
    65	      PicEtAff.map C L
    66	          (picEtAffineEquiv C (Over.testPointField t)
    67	            (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) (chartTwist C m Z T lam)))
    68	        = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M) ∧
    69	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W = M ∧
    70	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W = (n : ℤ) ∧
    71	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
    72	        ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) 1) ∧
    73	      (Sheaf.h0 ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) : ℤ)
    74	        = (n : ℤ) + 1 - (g : ℤ) := by
    75	  obtain ⟨L, hLf, hLa, hLKa, hLtow, hLfin, hLsep, M, hM, W, hWcl, hWh1⟩ := ht
    76	  haveI : IsIntegral (relCurve C L) := instIsIntegralBaseChange C L
    77	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    78	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L
    79	  haveI : QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    80	    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L
    81	  haveI : Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0) :=
    82	    instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C L
    83	  haveI : Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1) :=
    84	    instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C L
    85	  have hWdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W = (n : ℤ) := by
    86	    rw [← classDeg_picClass (K := L) W, hWcl,
    87	      classDeg_presenting_eq_degAff C L _ M hM]
    88	    change degAt (chartTwist C m Z T lam) (Over.testPoint t) = (n : ℤ)
    89	    rw [chartTwist, degAt_mul, degAt_inv, degAt_mul, degAt_thetaFamily_pow,
    90	      degAt_sigmaFamily, hlam, hdeg]
    91	    ring
    92	  have hχL : Sheaf.chi (((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).moduleKSheaf L) = 1 - (g : ℤ) :=
    93	    chi_relCurve_baseField C L g hχ
    94	  have hrank := h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one (K := L) W hWh1
    95	  rw [hWdeg, hχL] at hrank
    96	  refine ⟨L, hLf, hLa, hLKa, hLtow, hLfin, hLsep, M, W, hM, hWcl, hWdeg, hWh1, ?_⟩
    97	  omega
    98	
    99	/-- Above the genus parameter, chart-locus membership supplies a witness with at least two
   100	sections.  Thus the
   101	large-parameter vanishing route and the `h⁰ = 1` uniqueness route are genuinely different
   102	branches of the representability argument. -/
   103	theorem exists_splitting_two_le_h0_of_mem_chartLocus
   104	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : picEt C T) (t : T.left)
   105	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor) (n g : ℕ)
   106	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   107	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
   108	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
   109	    (hlam : degAt lam (Over.testPoint t) = 0) (hgn : g < n)
   110	    (ht : t ∈ chartLocus C m Z lam) :
   111	    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra (Over.testPointField t) L)
   112	        (_ : IsScalarTower k (Over.testPointField t) L)
   113	        (_ : Module.Finite (Over.testPointField t) L)
   114	        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable (Over.testPointField t) L)
   115	        (M : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
   116	        (W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor),
   117	      PicEtAff.map C L
   118	          (picEtAffineEquiv C (Over.testPointField t)
   119	            (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) (chartTwist C m Z T lam)))
   120	        = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M) ∧
   121	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W = M ∧
   122	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W = (n : ℤ) ∧
   123	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   124	        ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) 1) ∧
   125	      2 ≤ Sheaf.h0 ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) := by
   126	  obtain ⟨L, hLf, hLa, hLKa, hLtow, hLfin, hLsep, M, W, hM, hWcl, hWdeg, hWh1,
   127	      hrank⟩ := exists_splitting_h0_formula_of_mem_chartLocus
   128	        lam t m Z n g hdeg hχ hlam ht
   129	  refine ⟨L, hLf, hLa, hLKa, hLtow, hLfin, hLsep, M, W, hM, hWcl, hWdeg, hWh1, ?_⟩
   130	  have htwo : (2 : ℤ) ≤
   131	      (Sheaf.h0 ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) : ℤ) := by
   132	    rw [hrank]
   133	    omega
   134	  exact_mod_cast htwo
   135	
   136	/-! ## The actual unconditional coverage parameter -/
   137	
   138	/-- On a positive-genus curve, the unconditional admissible coverage parameter is strictly
   139	larger than the genus.
   140	
   141	The strictness does not add a cohomological hypothesis: `h⁰(𝒪_C) = 1` follows from the standing
   142	proper, smooth, geometrically irreducible assumptions.  If the ledger contribution above `g`
   143	were nonpositive, `genus_eq_zero_of_windowBound_nonpos` would contradict `g ≠ 0`. -/
   144	theorem genus_lt_admissibleCoverageParameter_of_ne_zero
   145	    {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] [IsDominant π]
   146	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   147	    (g : ℕ) (hg : g ≠ 0)
   148	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ)) :
   149	    letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
   150	    haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   151	      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
   152	    haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
   153	    haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   154	      inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
   155	    haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   156	      inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
   157	    haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
   158	      moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
   159	    haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
   160	      moduleFinite_hModule_one C
   161	    g < admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) hπ g := by
   162	  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
   163	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   164	    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
   165	  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
   166	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   167	    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
   168	  haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   169	    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
   170	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
   171	    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
   172	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
   173	    moduleFinite_hModule_one C
   174	  have hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 := h0_moduleKSheaf C
   175	  have hb : 0 < windowBound π hπ := by
   176	    by_contra hnonpos
   177	    exact hg (genus_eq_zero_of_windowBound_nonpos π hπ g
   178	      (not_lt.mp hnonpos) hO hχ)
   179	  have hM := windowBound_le_M_mul π hπ g
   180	  have hledger : (g : ℤ) <
   181	      (windowM_choice π hπ g : ℤ) * windowδ π + (g : ℤ) := by
   182	    omega
   183	  have hadmissible := ledgerBound_le_admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) hπ g
   184	  have hcast : (g : ℤ) <
   185	      (admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) hπ g : ℤ) :=
   186	    hledger.trans_le hadmissible
   187	  exact_mod_cast hcast
   188	
   189	/-- For positive genus, the uniform full-locus coverage chart supplies a splitting witness with
   190	at least two sections at every degree-zero fibre point.
   191	
   192	This is the direct join between `exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart` and the rank formula:
   193	the large parameter solves vanishing and coverage, but it cannot simultaneously be read as the
   194	genus-parameter `h⁰ = 1` chart used by the unique-effective-representative route. -/
   195	theorem exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_two_le_h0
   196	    {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] [IsDominant π]
   197	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   198	    (g : ℕ) (hg : g ≠ 0)
   199	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ)) :
   200	    letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
   201	    haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   202	      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
   203	    haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
   204	    haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   205	      inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
   206	    haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   207	      inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
   208	    haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
   209	      moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
   210	    haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
   211	      moduleFinite_hModule_one C
   212	    ∃ (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor),
   213	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   214	          = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C)
   215	            - (admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) hπ g : ℤ) ∧
   216	        ∀ {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : picEt C T) (t : T.left),
   217	          degAt lam (Over.testPoint t) = 0 →
   218	            ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L)
   219	                (_ : Algebra (Over.testPointField t) L)
   220	                (_ : IsScalarTower k (Over.testPointField t) L)
   221	                (_ : Module.Finite (Over.testPointField t) L)
   222	                (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable (Over.testPointField t) L)
   223	                (M : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
   224	                (W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor),
   225	              PicEtAff.map C L
   226	                  (picEtAffineEquiv C (Over.testPointField t)
   227	                    (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) (chartTwist C m Z T lam)))
   228	                = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M) ∧
   229	              Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W = M ∧
   230	              Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W
   231	                = (admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) hπ g : ℤ) ∧
   232	              Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   233	                ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) 1) ∧
   234	              2 ≤ Sheaf.h0 ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) := by
   235	  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
   236	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   237	    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
   238	  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
   239	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   240	    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
   241	  haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   242	    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
   243	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
   244	    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
   245	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
   246	    moduleFinite_hModule_one C
   247	  obtain ⟨m, Z, hZ, hcover⟩ := exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart hπ g hχ
   248	  refine ⟨m, Z, hZ, ?_⟩
   249	  intro T lam t hlam
   250	  exact exists_splitting_two_le_h0_of_mem_chartLocus lam t m Z
   251	    (admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) hπ g) g hZ hχ hlam
   252	    (genus_lt_admissibleCoverageParameter_of_ne_zero hπ g hg hχ)
   253	    (hcover lam t hlam)
   254	
   255	end
   256	
   257	end AlgebraicGeometry

     9	
    10	/-!
    11	# CHART-U(a): `chartLocus`, the chart-membership locus over a general test
    12	
    13	The co-signed brick of `informal/w4-datc-worksheet.md` §3.3 (CHART-U(a)) and
    14	`informal/w4-datb-worksheet.md` §1.6, in the SPLIT form the (a-amendment) binds:
    15	
    16	> `t ∈ chartLocus c λ` iff for some (equivalently every) finite separable `L/κ(t)`
    17	> splitting the collapsed plus class, the honest `L`-class of `λ_t · θ^m · (−Σ)` admits
    18	> an effective witness divisor with vanishing `H¹`.
    19	
    20	Everything here is over a GENERAL test `T` and an ARBITRARY plus class
    21	`λ ∈ pic0Subgroup C T`.  That is what distinguishes it from
    22	`Picard/Pic0ChartLocusClass.lean`'s `cechWitnessLocus`, which lives over an affine base
    23	and reads an UNTWISTED `CechPic` class; the module header there says so, and this file is
    24	the promised general-test article.
    25	
    26	## The layering, and why the split predicate is a *definition* here and not a disjunction
    27	
    28	Three separate things had to be joined, and they are joined in three steps:
    29	
    30	1. `Over.testPoint` (`Picard/Pic0ChartTestPoint.lean`) turns a point `t : T.left` into a
    31	   field point `overSpec k κ(t) ⟶ T`, so that `picEtMap C (testPoint t) λ` is the fibre
    32	   class of `λ` at `t`.  Without it there is no way to even state the predicate over a
    33	   general test.
    34	2. `IsSplitWitness` reads a plus class over a FIELD.  A plus class over a field is
    35	   `PicEtAff.mk E x` for an étale cover `E`, which is *not* an honest Čech class; the
    36	   (a-amendment)'s "finite separable `L` splitting the class" is exactly
    37	   `Algebra.EtaleCover.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom` (`Algebra/EtaleCover.lean:287`)
    38	   applied to `E`, after which `PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_relPicMk_of_algHom`
    39	   (`Picard/PicEtAffFieldCollapse.lean:101`) presents the class as `relPicMk` of an honest
    40	   Čech class over `C_L`.  The predicate is then the tree's witness predicate on that Čech
    41	   class.
    42	3. `chartLocus` twists by the chart index `(m, Σ)` — the same twist
    43	   `abelDiv · sigmaFamily Σ · (θ^m)⁻¹` that `chartValue` (`Picard/DivSchemeAbel.lean:351`)
    44	   applies on the divisor side — and reads step 2 at step 1's field point.
    45	
    46	The "some (equivalently every)" of the amendment is the honest content: the ∃-form is what
    47	one *proves* (coverage produces one splitting, §1.2 step 6), the ∀-form is what one
    48	*consumes* (any presenting splitting is a sound test).  Their agreement is
    49	`isSplitWitness_iff_forall`, and it rests on
    50	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_separable`
    51	(`Picard/Pic0ChartLocusFibreField.lean:157`) — the separable-invariance that lane co-owned

   110	/-! ## The split witness predicate at a class over a field -/
   111	
   112	variable (C) in
   113	/-- **The split witness predicate** (CHART-U(a) in the `w4-datb` §1.6 (a-amendment)
   114	spelling), at a plus class `μ` over a field `K`.
   115	
   116	A plus class over a field need not be an honest Čech class — it is `PicEtAff.mk E x` for
   117	an étale cover `E` of `K`.  The amendment's "for some finite separable `L/κ(t)` splitting
   118	the collapsed plus class" is this: there is a finite separable extension `L/K` over which
   119	`μ` becomes `relPicMk` of an honest Čech class `M` on `C_L`, and `M` admits an effective
   120	witness divisor with vanishing `H¹`.
   121	
   122	Stated with the witness clause on a *presenting Čech class* rather than on a datum,
   123	because the datum layer is where the shifted-datum constructor (DAT-C GAP-1) is missing;
   124	the two agree through `Pic0ChartLocusClass.mem_cechWitnessLocus_iff_exists`.
   125	
   126	## A convention this predicate INHERITS, and which a consumer must not misread
   127	
   128	The worksheets say "effective degree-`g` witness with `h¹ = 0`".  The witness clause here —
   129	and the tree's `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.HasWitnessH1Vanishing`
   130	(`Pic0ChartLocusFibreField.lean:115`) that it mirrors, and the GAP-6 dictionary
   131	`subsingleton_h1_tensor_iff_exists_witness` (`DivisorFamilyH1Locus.lean:182`) that both rest
   132	on — asks for **neither `0 ≤ W` nor `deg W = g`**.  It asks only for a `CurveDivisor` in the
   133	class with vanishing `H¹`.  That is deliberate on the tree's side: the dictionary is an *iff*
   134	against the engine's complex-form condition `Subsingleton (H¹(pair D) ⊗ L)`, and that
   135	condition cannot see effectivity or degree, so adding either clause would break the iff and
   136	with it the openness route.
   137	
   138	Two consequences, both load-bearing:
   139	
   140	* the degree is supplied **externally**, by the chart-index constraint through
   141	  `degAt_chartTwist` below: on a degree-zero `λ` the twisted class has fibre degree
   142	  `m·d₁ − deg Z`, which the constraint `deg Z = m·d₁ − g` makes `+g`.  It is *not* a
   143	  hypothesis of this predicate.  (Until 2026-07-28 this read `−g`, and that sign made the
   144	  locus empty for every `g ≥ 1` — see `degAt_chartTwist` and issue I-0514;
   145	  `chartTwist_chartValue` now pins the direction by the kernel);
   146	* effectivity likewise is not asserted here.  Where the *worksheet's* stronger reading is
   147	  actually needed — the canonical-section normalization `h⁰ = 1`, and GAP-2 uniqueness
   148	  (`Scheme.CurveDivisor.eq_of_picClass_eq_of_h0_one`, which does take `0 ≤ D`, `0 ≤ D'`) — the
   149	  effectivity must be re-supplied at that point.  A lane that reads `IsSplitWitness` as
   150	  already giving it will have a gap where it least expects one. -/
   151	def IsSplitWitness {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   152	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K)) : Prop :=
   153	  ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra K L)
   154	      (_ : IsScalarTower k K L) (_ : Module.Finite K L) (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L)
   155	      (M : (relCurve C L).CechPic),
   156	    PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K μ)
   157	        = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M)
   158	      ∧ ∃ W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor,
   159	          Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W = M
   160	            ∧ Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   161	                ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) 1)
   162	
   163	/-! ## The twisted fibre family -/
   164	
   165	variable (C) in
   166	/-- **The twisted family whose chart-membership `chartLocus` tests**: the plus class `λ`
   167	shifted by the Σ-family of `Z` and by `m` inverse powers of the pinned θ-family.
   168	
   169	This is the *class-side* half of `chartValue` (`Picard/DivSchemeAbel.lean:351`): where
   170	`chartValue` twists the Abel class of a divisor family, `chartTwist` twists an arbitrary
   171	plus class by the same two factors.  A point of `chartLocus` is precisely a point at which
   172	`chartTwist` is realised by an effective divisor with no `H¹` — i.e. at which `λ` itself is
   173	a chart value, after undoing the twist. -/
   174	def chartTwist (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   175	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T) : picEt C T :=
   176	  lam * (thetaFamily C (thetaCechClass C) T ^ m) * (sigmaFamily C Z T)⁻¹
   177	
   178	/-- **The degree ledger of the twist**: at every field point the twisted family has fibre
   179	degree `m·d₁ − deg Z` when `λ` is degree-zero.  With the chart-index constraint
   180	`deg Z = m·d₁ − g` this is `+g`, which is the degree at which an effective witness with
   181	`h¹ = 0` can exist at all.
   182	
   183	**Sign discipline, and it was wrong here until 2026-07-28 (issue I-0514).**  `chartTwist`
   184	must be the INVERSE of `chartValue`'s twist, not the same one.  `chartValue` is
   185	`abelDiv · Σ · (θᵐ)⁻¹` (`DivSchemeAbel.lean:351`), so recovering the Abel class from a chart
   186	value means multiplying by `θᵐ` and dividing by `Σ` — hence `chartTwist` is
   187	`λ · θᵐ · Σ⁻¹`.  An earlier version applied the `chartValue` twist itself, giving fibre degree
   188	`deg Z − m·d₁ = −g`; since `Subsingleton H¹(𝒪(W))` forces `deg W ≥ g − 1`, that locus was
   189	**empty for every `g ≥ 1`** and its openness was the openness of `∅`.  The comparison point is
   190	`degAt_chartValue` at `n = g` (where the chart index is calibrated and `chartValue` lands in
   191	`pic0`), NOT at `n = 0`.
   192	
   193	**An independent confirmation that `+g` is the right target**, worth recording because the
   194	wrong sign survived two sessions: at `deg W = g` the rank anchor
   195	`h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one` (`RiemannRoch/FLVClass.lean:412`) gives, for a
   196	witness with `h¹ = 0`,
   197	`h⁰ = deg W + χ(𝒪) = g + (1 − g) = 1` — exactly the `h⁰ = 1` normalization that DAT-C §2 and
   198	GAP-2's uniqueness both require.  So `+g` is not merely the sign that makes the locus nonempty;
   199	it is the unique degree at which the witness is *unique*, which is what the chart map needs to be
   200	injective.  At `−g` the same anchor gives `h⁰ = 1 − 2g`, negative for `g ≥ 1` — the contradiction
   201	that made the locus empty. -/
   202	theorem degAt_chartTwist (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   203	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {lam : picEt C T} (hlam : lam ∈ pic0Subgroup C T)
   204	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] (t : overSpec k K ⟶ T) :
   205	    degAt (chartTwist C m Z T lam) t
   206	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z := by
   207	  rw [chartTwist, degAt_mul, degAt_inv, degAt_mul, degAt_thetaFamily_pow,
   208	    degAt_sigmaFamily, (mem_pic0Subgroup_iff.mp hlam) K t]
   209	  ring
   210	
   211	/-- **`chartTwist` inverts `chartValue`'s twist** — the sign check, as a theorem rather than a
   212	docstring claim.
   213	
   214	Applying `chartTwist` to a chart value returns the Abel class it came from.  This is the
   215	statement that was FALSE of the earlier definition (which returned
   216	`abelDiv · Σ² · (θᵐ)⁻²`), and it is why the direction is now pinned by the kernel: any future
   217	edit to `chartTwist` that breaks the inversion breaks this lemma.
   218	
   219	Recorded per issue I-0514.  A degree ledger alone does not catch a sign error — the wrong-signed
   220	ledger was internally consistent — but an inversion law does. -/
   221	theorem chartTwist_chartValue {n : ℕ} (m : ℕ)
   222	    (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor) (T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   223	    (s : divFamZar C π n T) :
   224	    chartTwist C m Z T (chartValue C π n m Z T s) = abelDiv C π n T s := by
   225	  rw [chartTwist, chartValue]
   226	  group

   229	
   230	variable (C) in
   231	/-- **CHART-U(a), `chartLocus`** (`w4-datc` §3.3, co-signed `w4-datb` §1.6): the set of
   232	points of a general test `T` at which the twisted fibre class `λ_t · θ^m · (−Σ)` has, after
   233	some finite separable splitting of the collapsed plus class at `κ(t)`, an effective witness
   234	divisor with vanishing `H¹`.
   235	
   236	The three layers, each supplied by a named brick:
   237	* the *point-to-field-point* passage is `Over.testPoint` (input 0 of this brick — the one
   238	  nothing in the tree had);
   239	* the *twist* is `chartTwist`, the class-side avatar of `chartValue`;
   240	* the *split witness reading over a field* is `IsSplitWitness`.
   241	
   242	This is the RESERVED name of `Pic0ChartLocusClass.lean`'s header, now defined.  Note it is
   243	strictly stronger than `cechWitnessLocus`: general test, twisted class, split predicate. -/
   244	def chartLocus (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   245	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : picEt C T) : Set T.left :=
   246	  {t : T.left | IsSplitWitness C
   247	    (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) (chartTwist C m Z T lam))}
   248	
   249	theorem mem_chartLocus_iff (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   250	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : picEt C T) (t : T.left) :
   251	    t ∈ chartLocus C m Z lam ↔ IsSplitWitness C
   252	      (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) (chartTwist C m Z T lam)) :=
   253	  Iff.rfl

   255	/-! ## The datum-layer reading
   256	
   257	The witness clause of `IsSplitWitness` is stated on a presenting Čech class over `C_L`.
   258	The tree's *engine-facing* predicate is stated on a `BasicOpenCocycleDatum`
   259	(`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.HasWitnessH1Vanishing`, `Pic0ChartLocusFibreField.lean:115`), and
   260	the two are joined by `exists_cechPicClass_eq` (every class is presented) plus
   261	class-intrinsicity.  This is the seam CHART-U(b) crosses to reach
   262	`datumRigidEngine_isOpen_vanishing`, so it is recorded here as a lemma of the definition
   263	rather than left implicit in the openness proof. -/
   264	
   265	/-- **The witness clause at a splitting field, in datum form**: for a Čech class `M` over
   266	`C_L`, admitting an effective witness divisor with vanishing `H¹` is exactly
   267	`HasWitnessH1Vanishing` of any datum presenting `M` — as a class over the base `L` itself,
   268	where `relCurveMap C L L` is the identity comparison.
   269	
   270	Note the datum lives over the *field* `L` as base ring, which is the affine base the
   271	engine's `PrimeSpectrum L` has a unique point of; that is why the fibre reading and the
   272	base reading coincide here. -/
   273	theorem exists_witness_iff_hasWitnessH1Vanishing_of_datum
   274	    {L : Type u} [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   275	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C L π) {M : (relCurve C L).CechPic}
   276	    (hD : Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C L L) D.cechPicClass
   277	      = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C L L) M) :
   278	    (∃ W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor,
   279	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C L L) M
   280	          ∧ Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   281	              ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) 1))
   282	      ↔ D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing L := by
   283	  rw [BasicOpenCocycleDatum.HasWitnessH1Vanishing, hD]
   284	
   285	/-- **Upward closure of the witness clause along a separable extension of the splitting
   286	field** — the substantive half of the (a-amendment)'s "some (equivalently every)".
   287	
   288	If a Čech class `M` over `C_L` has an effective witness divisor with vanishing `H¹`, then
   289	so does its base change to any finite separable `L'/L`.  This is what makes two splittings
   290	of the same plus class comparable: pass to a common separable extension and compare there,
   291	rather than comparing the two splittings directly.
   292	
   293	Proof: present `M` by a datum `D` over `L` (`exists_cechPicClass_eq`); the witness clause at
   294	`L` is `D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing L`, which transfers to `L'` by the co-owned separable
   295	invariance `hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_separable`
   296	(`Pic0ChartLocusFibreField.lean:157` — itself resting only on faithful flatness of a field
   297	extension, so separability is packaging, not content). -/
   298	theorem exists_witness_of_separable_extension (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite π]
   299	    {L : Type u} [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   300	    {L' : Type u} [Field L'] [Algebra k L'] [Algebra L L'] [IsScalarTower k L L']

   145	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
