   152	/-! ## The residue of the chain, named -/
   153	
   154	variable (C π) in
   155	/-- **The shifted-datum presentation hypothesis** — the one link of the CHART-U(b) route of
   156	record that is not landed, stated exactly.
   157	
   158	Over an affine test `Spec A`, for a class `μ : picEt C (overSpec k A)` (in practice the
   159	twisted family `chartTwist C m Z _ λ` restricted to the test), a presentation is a
   160	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum` over `A` whose fibre witness predicate at every residue field agrees
   161	with the split witness predicate of `μ` at the corresponding point.
   162	
   163	Two remarks on the shape, both deliberate:
   164	
   165	* it is stated as an **agreement of predicates at every point**, not as a class equality.
   166	  That is weaker than "the datum's class is `μ`", and it is all the openness argument
   167	  consumes — which matters, because the class equality is what needs `cechPicClass_inv` and
   168	  a class-level identification, whereas a lane that can produce the pointwise agreement by any
   169	  other route may use this theorem immediately;
   170	* the split predicate is read at `Over.testPoint`, i.e. at the canonical residue-field point
   171	  of the affine test, so no choice of affine chart enters;
   172	* the `Algebra A (testPointField t)` / `IsScalarTower k A (testPointField t)` instances the
   173	  datum predicate needs are the **canonical** ones of `Picard/Pic0ChartTestPoint.lean`.  An
   174	  earlier draft of this file carried them as explicit `alg`/`tow` arguments; that was strictly
   175	  worse — it made the statement false for some regradings (`HasWitnessH1Vanishing` reads its
   176	  `Algebra` instance inside `relCurveMap`, so a non-canonical `alg` names a different set) as
   177	  well as unusable. -/
   178	def IsChartDatumPresentation {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   179	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k A)) (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C A π) : Prop :=
   180	  ∀ t : (overSpec k A).left,
   181	    D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)
   182	      ↔ IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) μ)
   183	
   184	/-! ## The carrier translation: `testPointField` on `Spec A` versus `Ideal.ResidueField`
   185	
   186	The engine's open set lives in `PrimeSpectrum A` and is indexed by `q.asIdeal.ResidueField`;
   187	`chartLocus` lives in `(overSpec k A).left = Spec A` and is indexed by `Over.testPointField`.
   188	The two carriers are the same space, but the two *fields* are only canonically isomorphic
   189	(mathlib's `Spec.residueFieldIso`), so the witness predicate has to be carried across that
   190	isomorphism.  That is what this section does, and it is the transport the (b-amendment) folds
   191	into "affine pieces glue by (V1c)-style locality". -/
   192	
   193	/-- **The residue-field comparison at a point of an affine test, as an algebra map.**
   194	
   195	`Over.testPointField t` is the *scheme* residue field `(Spec A).residueField t`, while every
   196	engine-facing predicate reads the *algebraic* residue field `t.asIdeal.ResidueField` of the
   197	prime.  Mathlib's `Spec.residueFieldIso` identifies them; this records the identification in
   198	the form the tower needs, namely that the canonical `A`-algebra structure on the scheme
   199	residue field (`Over.instAlgebraTestPointFieldAffine`) factors through the algebraic one.
   200	
   201	Proof: both sides are `Spec.preimage` of a morphism out of `Spec κ(t)`, and `Spec.map` is
   202	injective on homs, so it suffices to compare after applying `Spec.map` — where the identity is
   203	mathlib's `Spec.map_residueFieldIso_inv_eq_fromSpecResidueField`. -/
   204	lemma algebraMap_testPointFieldAffine_factors {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   205	    (t : (overSpec k A).left) :
   206	    algebraMap A (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)
   207	      = ((Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso (.of A) t).inv).hom.comp
   208	          (algebraMap A (t : PrimeSpectrum A).asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
   209	  rw [Over.algebraMap_testPointFieldAffine]
   210	  have h : Spec.preimage ((overSpec k A).left.fromSpecResidueField t)
   211	      = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (t : PrimeSpectrum A).asIdeal.ResidueField)
   212	          ≫ (Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso (.of A) t).inv := by
   213	    apply Spec.map_injective
   214	    rw [Spec.map_preimage, Spec.map_comp]
   215	    exact (Scheme.Spec.map_residueFieldIso_inv_eq_fromSpecResidueField (.of A) t).symm
   216	  rw [h]
   217	  rfl
   218	
   219	/-- **The witness predicate at a scheme-residue field agrees with the one at the prime's
   220	residue field, and the resulting locus is open.**
   221	
   222	`Over.testPointField t` is `(Spec A).residueField t` and the engine reads
   223	`t.asIdeal.ResidueField`; `Spec.residueFieldIso` identifies them, and the witness predicate
   224	transfers along any field extension in the `A`-tower
   225	(`hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension`, `Pic0ChartLocusFibreField.lean:142`), in
   226	particular along an isomorphism.
   227	
   228	Three points about the proof, each of which was a suspected wall and is not:
   229	
   230	* the **carrier identification** `↥(overSpec k A).left = PrimeSpectrum A` is *definitional*
   231	  (`Scheme.Spec`'s carrier is `PrimeSpectrum` on the nose), so the two index sets need no
   232	  transport and the two topologies agree by `rfl`.  The set equality below is therefore a
   233	  pointwise `Iff`, not a homeomorphism argument;
   234	* the `Algebra A (testPointField t)` and `IsScalarTower k A (testPointField t)` instances the
   235	  predicate needs are **already canonical** (`Over.instAlgebraTestPointFieldAffine`,
   236	  `Over.instIsScalarTowerTestPointFieldAffine`), so nothing has to be passed in as an
   237	  argument.  An earlier draft of this file took `alg`/`tow` as explicit hypotheses and left
   238	  the conclusion as a `sorry`; that was a statement-shape artifact, not a gap — and worse,
   239	  the hypothesis form is *false for some regradings*, since an arbitrary `alg` need not be the
   240	  canonical instance and the predicate is not invariant under regrading the field over `A`;
   241	* the only genuine content is the transport across `Spec.residueFieldIso`, which is
   242	  `hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension` applied to the isomorphism, in the tower
   243	  `A → κ(q) → (Spec A).residueField t` supplied by
   244	  `algebraMap_testPointFieldAffine_factors`. -/
   245	theorem isOpen_setOf_hasWitnessH1Vanishing_testPointField
   246	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom) {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   247	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C A π) :
   248	    IsOpen {t : (overSpec k A).left |
   249	      D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)} := by
   250	  -- The two loci are the SAME set of the SAME type: `↥(overSpec k A).left` is
   251	  -- `PrimeSpectrum A` definitionally, so only the fibre field differs, and the predicate is
   252	  -- invariant under the isomorphism between the two readings of it.
   253	  have hset : {t : (overSpec k A).left |
   254	        D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)}
   255	      = {q : PrimeSpectrum A |
   256	          ∃ W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k q.asIdeal.ResidueField).left).CurveDivisor,
   257	            Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass q.asIdeal.ResidueField W
   258	                = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C A q.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   259	                    D.cechPicClass
   260	              ∧ Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   261	                  ((C ⊗ overSpec k q.asIdeal.ResidueField).left.divisorSheaf
   262	                    q.asIdeal.ResidueField W) 1)} := by
   263	    refine Set.ext fun t => ?_
   264	    -- the comparison iso as an algebra structure, and its tower over `A`
   265	    letI : Algebra (t : PrimeSpectrum A).asIdeal.ResidueField
   266	        (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) :=
   267	      ((Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso (.of A) t).inv).hom.toAlgebra
   268	    haveI : IsScalarTower A (t : PrimeSpectrum A).asIdeal.ResidueField
   269	        (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) :=
   270	      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (algebraMap_testPointFieldAffine_factors t)
   271	    exact (D.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension
   272	      (t : PrimeSpectrum A).asIdeal.ResidueField
   273	      (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)).symm
   274	  rw [hset]
   275	  exact D.isOpen_setOf_exists_witness_h1_vanishing hπ
   276	
   277	/-! ## Transports (0) and (iii): the identification with the landed locus -/
   278	
   279	/-- **`chartLocus` over an affine test is the witness locus of a presenting datum.**
   280	
   281	This is transport (0) (the class-indexation, landed as `cechWitnessLocus`) composed with
   282	transport (iii) (locality on the affine test, here trivial because the test *is* affine),
   283	run against the presentation hypothesis.  The content is entirely the translation between
   284	the two ways the tree indexes a fibre — by a point of the test object's space
   285	(`Over.testPoint`, the `chartLocus` side) and by a prime of the test algebra
   286	(`q.asIdeal.ResidueField`, the engine side).
   287	
   288	The translation is available precisely because `Over.testPointField` at a point of
   289	`(overSpec k A).left = Spec A` and `q.asIdeal.ResidueField` at the corresponding prime are
   290	the same field up to the canonical `Spec.residueFieldIso`, and the witness predicate is
   291	invariant under field isomorphism over the base (`hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension`
   292	applied to an isomorphism). -/
   293	theorem mem_chartLocus_iff_hasWitnessH1Vanishing
   294	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   295	    {μ : picEt C (overSpec k A)} {D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C A π}
   296	    (hpres : IsChartDatumPresentation C π μ D) (t : (overSpec k A).left) :
   297	    IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) μ)
   298	      ↔ D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) :=
   299	  (hpres t).symm
   300	
   301	/-! ## The keystone, conditionally -/
   302	
   303	variable (C π) in
   304	/-- **`isOpen_chartLocus`, given the shifted-datum presentation** (dat-b row B-4's keystone,
   305	over an affine test).
   306	
   307	The proof is the route of record with the one missing link supplied as `hpres`: rewrite
   308	membership of `chartLocus` as the datum's witness predicate at the residue field of the
   309	point (the presentation), then quote the landed datum-level openness
   310	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.isOpen_setOf_exists_witness_h1_vanishing` — itself the engine
   311	`datumRigidEngine_isOpen_vanishing` read through the GAP-6 dictionary.
   312	
   313	The general-test statement follows from this one by the affine-piece locality of the
   314	(b-amendment)'s transport (iii): `chartLocus` over `T` meets each affine open `U ⊆ T.left` in
   315	`chartLocus` over `Spec Γ(T.left, U)` (by `picEtMap_chartTwist` along
   316	`Over.fromSpecAffine T U`), and a set that is open in every member of an open cover is open.
   317	That last step is `isOpen_iff_forall_isOpen_inter`-style bookkeeping and needs no new
   318	mathematics; it is not stated here only because it would need the presentation hypothesis
   319	*per affine piece*, which is a statement about the general test and therefore belongs with
   320	the honesty/presentation obligations named in the header table. -/
   321	theorem isOpen_setOf_isSplitWitness_of_presentation (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   322	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   323	    {μ : picEt C (overSpec k A)} {D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C A π}
   324	    (hpres : IsChartDatumPresentation C π μ D) :
   325	    IsOpen {t : (overSpec k A).left |
   326	      IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) μ)} := by
   327	  -- The engine's open set is indexed by primes of `A`; the locus is indexed by points of
   328	  -- `Spec A`.  These carriers are the same type, so the presentation rewrites one into the
   329	  -- other pointwise.
   330	  have hset : {t : (overSpec k A).left |
   331	        IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) μ)}
   332	      = {t : (overSpec k A).left |
   333	          D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)} :=
   334	    Set.ext fun t => mem_chartLocus_iff_hasWitnessH1Vanishing hpres t
   335	  rw [hset]
   336	  exact isOpen_setOf_hasWitnessH1Vanishing_testPointField hπ D

     8	/-!
     9	# CHART-U(b) — datum-level openness of the chart-membership (witness) locus
    10	(`informal/w4-datb-worksheet.md` §1.6, `informal/w4-datc-worksheet.md` §3.3)
    11	
    12	The affine-level heart of the shared CHART-U(b) brick, stated directly on a pinned
    13	basic-open cocycle datum in the **witness form** the `chartLocus` predicate uses.
    14	
    15	For a datum `D` over an affine base `B`, the locus of primes `q` of `B` at which the
    16	fibre class of `D` at `κ(q)` admits an effective witness divisor with vanishing `H¹`
    17	is Zariski-open in `Spec B`.  This is the single sanctioned openness mechanism of the
    18	campaign (`datumRigidEngine_isOpen_vanishing`, Noetherian-free — dat-d §3.5) read
    19	through the two-way datum dictionary of C1
    20	(`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.subsingleton_h1_tensor_iff_exists_witness`,
    21	`informal/w4-datc-worksheet.md` GAP-6): the engine open is the complex-form fibre
    22	condition `Subsingleton (H¹(pair D) ⊗[B] κ(q))`, and the dictionary rewrites it,
    23	pointwise and class-intrinsically, as the effective-witness/h¹-vanishing condition.
    24	
    25	Role in the CHART-U(b) chain (the two unlanded links of §5 risk 1):
    26	
    27	* **the shifted-datum constructor (link 1):** over the étale carrier `B` the plus
    28	  class collapses to an honest Čech class; twisted by the theta layer and DAT-C's
    29	  GAP-1 inverse datum into the `λθᵐ(Σ-shift)⁻¹` class, then extracted
    30	  (`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.exists_cechPicClass_eq`) to a datum `D`.  The output of
    31	  that link is exactly a `BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π` — the input of the theorem
    32	  below, whose witness set is then the `chartLocus`-over-`B`.
    33	* **the étale-image openness transport (link 2):** the locus over the test base `A`
    34	  is the image, under the (open, surjective) étale carrier map `Spec B → Spec A`, of
    35	  the open locus this theorem produces — carried to `A` by mathlib's
    36	  `IsOpenMap.isQuotientMap`/`IsQuotientMap.isOpen_preimage` once the fibre-field
    37	  invariance identifies the preimage.
    38	
    39	The theorem is class-intrinsic (any datum in the class has the same witness set, by
    40	(V1a)), so a change of extracted representative is free.
    41	-/

    69	/-- **CHART-U(b), the datum-level witness-locus openness** (`w4-datc` §3.3 step (3)):

    80	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.isOpen_setOf_exists_witness_h1_vanishing
    81	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π) (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom) :
    82	    IsOpen {q : PrimeSpectrum B |
    83	      ∃ W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k q.asIdeal.ResidueField).left).CurveDivisor,
    84	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass q.asIdeal.ResidueField W
    85	            = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B q.asIdeal.ResidueField) D.cechPicClass
    86	          ∧ Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
    87	              ((C ⊗ overSpec k q.asIdeal.ResidueField).left.divisorSheaf
    88	                q.asIdeal.ResidueField W) 1)} := by

    90	      ∃ W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k q.asIdeal.ResidueField).left).CurveDivisor,

    92	            = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B q.asIdeal.ResidueField) D.cechPicClass
    93	          ∧ Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
    94	              ((C ⊗ overSpec k q.asIdeal.ResidueField).left.divisorSheaf
    95	                q.asIdeal.ResidueField W) 1)}
    96	      = {p : PrimeSpectrum B |

    98	    refine Set.ext fun q => ?_

   103	/-! ## The openness transport (CHART-U(b) link 2, topological half)
   104	
   105	The engine produces the open witness locus over the étale carrier `Spec B` (or, on the
   106	away pieces, over `Spec (Localization.Away f)`).  CHART-U(b)'s transport (ii)
   107	(`w4-datb` §1.6, "the Kleiman tex 2204-2244 step, now one `IsOpenMap` application")
   108	carries it down to the test base `Spec A` along the étale carrier map, which is open
   109	and surjective.  The pure-topology core of that step is below; the remaining
   110	mathematical content of link 2 is the *fibre-field invariance* that identifies the
   111	preimage of the base locus with the carrier locus (`κ(q)/κ(p)` a separable extension;
   112	`isH1VanishingAt_comap_away_iff` is the landed avatar for the away case). -/
   113	
   114	/-- **Openness descends along an open continuous surjection**: if `f` is continuous,
   115	open, and surjective and `f ⁻¹' V` is open, then `V` is open — because
   116	`V = f '' (f ⁻¹' V)` (surjectivity) and `f` carries opens to opens.  This is the
   117	topological core of CHART-U(b)'s transport (ii). -/
   118	theorem isOpen_of_isOpen_preimage_of_isOpenMap_surjective
   119	    {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y}
   120	    (hcont : Continuous f) (hopen : IsOpenMap f) (hsurj : Function.Surjective f)
   121	    {V : Set Y} (hV : IsOpen (f ⁻¹' V)) : IsOpen V :=
   122	  ((hopen.isQuotientMap hcont hsurj).isOpen_preimage).mp hV
   123	
   124	/-- **The `Spec`-level openness transport of CHART-U(b)** (transport (ii), topological
   125	half): for a ring map `f : R →+* S` whose induced `Spec S → Spec R` is open and
   126	surjective (e.g. an étale carrier map), a locus of `Spec R` whose preimage in `Spec S`
   127	is open is itself open.  The engine's open witness locus lives on the carrier `Spec S`;
   128	this pushes it to the test base `Spec R`. -/
   129	theorem isOpen_of_isOpen_comap_preimage {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
   130	    (f : R →+* S) (hopen : IsOpenMap (PrimeSpectrum.comap f))
   131	    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap f))
   132	    {V : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)} (hV : IsOpen (PrimeSpectrum.comap f ⁻¹' V)) :

/-!
# The category of sheaves of modules over a scheme

In this file, we define the abelian category of sheaves of modules
`X.Modules` over a scheme `X`, and study its basic functoriality.

-/

@[expose] public section

universe t u

open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace SheafOfModules Bicategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

variable {X Y Z T : Scheme.{u}}

variable (X) in
/-- The category of sheaves of modules over a scheme. -/
def Modules := SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf

namespace Modules

/-- Morphisms between `𝒪ₓ`-modules. Use `Hom.app` to act on sections. -/
def Hom (M N : X.Modules) : Type u := SheafOfModules.Hom M N

instance : Category X.Modules where
  Hom := Modules.Hom
  __ := (inferInstance : Category (SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf))

noncomputable instance : Abelian X.Modules :=
  inferInstanceAs <| Abelian (SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf)
instance : HasLimits X.Modules := inferInstanceAs (HasLimits (SheafOfModules X.ringCatSheaf))
instance : HasColimits X.Modules := inferInstanceAs (HasColimits (SheafOfModules X.ringCatSheaf))

section Functor

variable (X) in
/-- The forgetful functor from `𝒪ₓ`-modules to presheaves of modules.
This is mostly useful to transport results from (pre)sheaves of modules to `𝒪ₓ`-modules and
usually shouldn't be used directly when working with actual `𝒪ₓ`-modules. -/
def toPresheafOfModules : X.Modules ⥤ X.PresheafOfModules := SheafOfModules.forget _

/-- The forgetful functor from `𝒪ₓ`-modules to presheaves of modules is fully faithful. -/
def fullyFaithfulToPresheafOfModules : (Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).FullyFaithful :=
  SheafOfModules.fullyFaithfulForget _

instance : (toPresheafOfModules X).Full := fullyFaithfulToPresheafOfModules.full
instance : (toPresheafOfModules X).Faithful := fullyFaithfulToPresheafOfModules.faithful
instance : (toPresheafOfModules X).IsRightAdjoint :=
  (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).isRightAdjoint

variable (X) in
/-- The forgetful functor from `𝒪ₓ`-modules to presheaves of abelian groups. -/
noncomputable def toPresheaf : X.Modules ⥤ TopCat.Presheaf Ab X :=
  toPresheafOfModules X ⋙ PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _

instance : (toPresheaf X).Faithful := .comp _ (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _)
instance : PreservesLimits (toPresheaf X) := comp_preservesLimits _ (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _)
instance : (toPresheaf X).ReflectsIsomorphisms :=
  reflectsIsomorphisms_comp _ (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _)

end Functor

variable {M N K : X.Modules} {φ : M ⟶ N} {U V : X.Opens}

section Presheaf

/-- The underlying abelian presheaf of an `𝒪ₓ`-module. -/
noncomputable def presheaf (M : X.Modules) : TopCat.Presheaf Ab X := M.1.presheaf

/-- Notation for sections of a presheaf of module. -/
scoped[AlgebraicGeometry] notation3 "Γ(" M ", " U ")" => (Scheme.Modules.presheaf M).obj (.op U)

instance : Module Γ(X, U) Γ(M, U) := (M.val.obj (.op U)).isModule

variable (M) in
@[simp] lemma map_smul (i : U ⟶ V) (r : Γ(X, V)) (x : Γ(M, V)) :
    M.presheaf.map i.op (r • x) = X.presheaf.map i.op r • M.presheaf.map i.op x :=
  M.val.map_smul _ _ _

/-- Scalar multiplication as an endomorphism of `Γ(M, U)`. -/
def smul : Γ(X, U) →+* End Γ(M, U) :=
  (M.val.obj (.op U)).smul

@[simp]
lemma smul_apply (r : Γ(X, U)) (x : Γ(M, U)) : (M.smul r).hom x = r • x := rfl

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma map_comp_smul (i : U ⟶ V) (r : Γ(X, V)) :
    M.smul r ≫ M.presheaf.map i.op = M.presheaf.map i.op ≫ M.smul (X.presheaf.map i.op r) := by
  ext
  simp

/-- The underlying map between abelian presheaves of a morphism of `𝒪ₓ`-modules. -/
noncomputable def Hom.mapPresheaf (φ : M ⟶ N) : M.presheaf ⟶ N.presheaf :=
  (toPresheaf X).map φ

/-- The application of a morphism of `𝒪ₓ`-modules to sections. -/
def Hom.app (φ : M ⟶ N) (U : X.Opens) : Γ(M, U) ⟶ Γ(N, U) :=
  (forget₂ _ _).map (φ.val.app (.op U))

@[simp] lemma mapPresheaf_app (φ : M ⟶ N) (U) : φ.mapPresheaf.app U = φ.app U.unop := rfl

@[simp]
lemma Hom.app_smul (φ : M ⟶ N) (r : Γ(X, U)) (x : Γ(M, U)) :
    φ.app U (r • x) = r • φ.app U x :=
  (φ.val.app (.op U)).hom.map_smul r x

@[simp] lemma Hom.add_app (φ ψ : M ⟶ N) : (φ + ψ).app U = φ.app U + ψ.app U := rfl
@[simp] lemma Hom.sub_app (φ ψ : M ⟶ N) : (φ - ψ).app U = φ.app U - ψ.app U := rfl
@[simp] lemma Hom.zero_app : (0 : M ⟶ N).app U = 0 := rfl
@[simp] lemma Hom.id_app (M : X.Modules) : (𝟙 M :).app U = 𝟙 _ := rfl
@[simp] lemma Hom.comp_app (φ : M ⟶ N) (ψ : N ⟶ K) : (φ ≫ ψ).app U = φ.app U ≫ ψ.app U := rfl

@[ext]
lemma hom_ext (f g : M ⟶ N) (H : ∀ U, f.app U = g.app U) : f = g := by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  ext U x
  exact congr($(H U.unop) x)

lemma isSheaf (M : X.Modules) : M.presheaf.IsSheaf := SheafOfModules.isSheaf M

@[simp] lemma toPresheaf_obj : (toPresheaf X).obj M = M.presheaf := rfl
@[simp] lemma toPresheaf_map : (toPresheaf X).map φ = φ.mapPresheaf := rfl

lemma Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app {M N : X.Modules} {φ : M ⟶ N} :
    IsIso φ ↔ ∀ U, IsIso (φ.app U) := by
  rw [← isIso_iff_of_reflects_iso _ (toPresheaf X), NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
  simp [Opposite.op_surjective.forall]

instance [IsIso φ] : IsIso (φ.app U) := Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app.mp ‹_› _

@[simp, push ←]
lemma inv_app [IsIso φ] : (inv φ).app U = inv (φ.app U) := by
  apply IsIso.eq_inv_of_hom_inv_id
  simp [← Hom.comp_app]

end Presheaf

noncomputable section Functorial

variable (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ T)

/-- The pushforward functor for categories of sheaves of modules over schemes. -/
def pushforward : X.Modules ⥤ Y.Modules :=
  SheafOfModules.pushforward f.toRingCatSheafHom

@[simp]
lemma pushforward_obj_obj (M : X.Modules) (U : Y.Opens) :
    Γ((pushforward f).obj M, U) = Γ(M, f ⁻¹ᵁ U) := rfl

@[simp]

    ((pushforward f).obj M).presheaf.map i.op = M.presheaf.map ((Opens.map f.base).map i).op := rfl

    ((pushforward f).map φ).app U = φ.app (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) := rfl

/-- The pullback functor for categories of sheaves of modules over schemes. -/
def pullback : Y.Modules ⥤ X.Modules :=
  SheafOfModules.pullback f.toRingCatSheafHom

/-- The pullback functor for categories of sheaves of modules over schemes
is left adjoint to the pushforward functor. -/

   222	/-- The `j`-th **component** of a global section of the datum's glued sheaf, as a
   223	section of the trivializing basic-open piece `D(h_j)` (the `⊤ ⊓ pieces j`-to-`pieces j`

   225	noncomputable def component (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
   226	    (j : D.index) : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) :=
   227	  (relCurve C B).resHom (le_inf le_top le_rfl) (s.val j)
   228	
   229	/-- Every piece of the pinned datum is an affine open (a basic open of a pinned affine
   230	chart). -/
   231	theorem isAffineOpen_pieces (j : D.index) : IsAffineOpen (D.pieces j) := by
   232	  cases j with
   233	  | inl j₀ => exact (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover π)).basicOpen (D.h₀ j₀)
   234	  | inr j₁ => exact (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B (fiberTwoCover π)).basicOpen (D.h₁ j₁)

   241	/-- **DAT-A2 on the datum, section-ring form**: a fibrewise-regular component of a
   242	global section of the DAT-1 glued sheaf is a nonzerodivisor of its piece ring
   243	(fibrewise-regular + flat ⟹ regular; the chart rings are free `B`-modules by
   244	`free_relSections`, so the pieces are flat, and the `lm:ctn`-lite core fires). -/
   245	theorem component_mem_nonZeroDivisors [IsNoetherianRing B]
   246	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤)) (j : D.index)
   247	    (hfib : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum B, Function.Injective
   248	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :
   249	    D.component s j ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) := by
   250	  cases j with
   251	  | inl j₀ =>
   252	      haveI : Module.Free B Γ(relCurve C B, (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀) :=
   253	        free_relSections C B (fiberChart₀ π)
   254	          (isAffineOpen_preimage_chartOpen π 0).isCompact
   255	          (isAffineOpen_preimage_chartOpen π 0).isQuasiSeparated
   256	      exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_fibrewise_regular B
   257	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover π)) (D.h₀ j₀)
   258	        Module.Flat.of_free (D.component s (Sum.inl j₀)) hfib
   259	  | inr j₁ =>
   260	      haveI : Module.Free B Γ(relCurve C B, (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁) :=
   261	        free_relSections C B (fiberChart₁ π)
   262	          (isAffineOpen_preimage_chartOpen π 1).isCompact
   263	          (isAffineOpen_preimage_chartOpen π 1).isQuasiSeparated
   264	      exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_fibrewise_regular B
   265	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B (fiberTwoCover π)) (D.h₁ j₁)
   266	        Module.Flat.of_free (D.component s (Sum.inr j₁)) hfib

   269	fibrewise-regular component has nonzerodivisor germs at every point of its piece. -/
   270	theorem germ_component_mem_nonZeroDivisors [IsNoetherianRing B]
   271	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤)) (j : D.index)
   272	    (hfib : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum B, Function.Injective

   278	    (D.component_mem_nonZeroDivisors s j hfib) y hy

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOnePresentation
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AdmissibleAbelEtaleSurjectiveEffectivity
     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyMonoH1
     9	import Mathlib.RingTheory.TensorProduct.Finite
    10	
    11	/-!
    12	# The consumed local divisor package for the rank-one route
    13	
    14	This module is the first divisor consumer of PicRankOneLocalPresentation.  The projective
    15	rank-one H0 module supplies a basic open and a section which is nonzero on every residue fibre
    16	there.  The datum-side section construction then gives regular local equations, and the widened
    17	effectivity engine packages those equations as a DivFamZarAff of degree genus C.
    18	
    19	The package is deliberately local and presentation-tied.  It does not define the canonical
    20	family-level divisorOfRankOne, identify the equations with the native zero locus, or assert
    21	that the rank-one locus is represented by an open subscheme.  Those remain the next contracts.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	
    26	universe u
    27	
    28	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    29	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    30	open scoped TensorProduct
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    35	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    36	
    37	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    38	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    39	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    40	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    41	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    42	variable {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    43	
    44	namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    45	
    46	/- The degree theorem needs the base-change geometric package under the local relCurve instance,
    47	   which has lower priority in the general curve API. -/
    48	noncomputable local instance (priority := 20000) rankOneLocalDivisorOver
    49	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    50	    (relCurve C L).Over (Spec (.of L)) :=
    51	  instOverBaseChange C L
    52	
    53	noncomputable local instance rankOneLocalDivisorSmooth
    54	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    55	    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
    56	  instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L
    57	
    58	noncomputable local instance rankOneLocalDivisorIntegral
    59	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    60	    IsIntegral (relCurve C L) :=
    61	  instIsIntegralBaseChange C L
    62	
    63	noncomputable local instance rankOneLocalDivisorQuasiCompact
    64	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    65	    QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
    66	  instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L
    67	
    68	noncomputable local instance rankOneLocalDivisorFiniteH0
    69	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    70	    Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0) :=
    71	  instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C L
    72	
    73	noncomputable local instance rankOneLocalDivisorFiniteH1
    74	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    75	    Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1) :=
    76	  instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C L
    77	
    78	/-! ## Regularity and degree of the local equations -/
    79	
    80	/-- The local equations cut from the tied datum section remain regular after every field-valued
    81	coefficient extension.  This is the regularity input consumed by the widened effectivity
    82	engine, derived from the same fibrewise nonvanishing hypothesis used in the construction. -/
    83	theorem baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_fibrewiseRegular
    84	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    85	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    86	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
    87	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    88	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
    89	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    90	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    91	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
    92	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    93	    [Algebra (Localization.Away f) L]
    94	    [IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away f) L]
    95	    (z : relCurve C L) :
    96	    ((relCurve C L).presheaf.germ
    97	      (((P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).cover.pullback
    98	        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)).opens z) z
    99	      (((P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).cover.pullback
   100	        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)).mem_opens z)).hom
   101	      (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn
   102	        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)
   103	        (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy) z) ∈
   104	      nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C L).presheaf.stalk z) := by
   105	  let B := Localization.Away f
   106	  let D := P.datum.baseChange B
   107	  let s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤) :=
   108	    P.datumSectionBaseChange B y
   109	  have hsec : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
   110	      D.sectionsMapTop q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   111	        (P.datumSectionBaseChange B y) ≠ 0 :=
   112	    fun q => P.sectionsMapTop_datumSectionBaseChange_away_ne_zero f y hy q
   113	  have hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (q : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
   114	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   115	    fun j q => D.injective_rTensor_component_of_sectionsMapTop_ne_zero
   116	      s q (hsec q) j
   117	  unfold baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange
   118	  exact D.germ_self_pullbackEqn_sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular
   119	    s hfib L z
   120	
   121	/-- The local equations have the genus class degree after every field-valued extension.  The
   122	calculation uses the datum class law and datum_classDeg_baseChange, so the degree is tied to
   123	the presentation rather than supplied as an unrelated witness. -/
   124	theorem baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_classDeg
   125	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   126	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   127	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   128	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   129	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   130	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   131	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   132	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   133	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   134	    [Algebra (Localization.Away f) L]
   135	    [IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away f) L] :
   136	    classDeg L
   137	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)
   138	        (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).picClass) = genus C := by
   139	  letI : Algebra P.cover.Carrier L :=
   140	    ((algebraMap (Localization.Away f) L).comp
   141	      (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f))).toAlgebra
   142	  haveI : IsScalarTower P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f) L :=
   143	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
   144	  haveI : IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L :=
   145	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
   146	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, RingHom.comp_assoc,
   147	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f),
   148	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k (Localization.Away f) L])
   149	  rw [P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_picClass f y hy,
   150	    P.datum.cechPicClass_baseChange (Localization.Away f),
   151	    ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp,
   152	    relCurveMap_comp]
   153	  exact P.datum_classDeg_baseChange L
   154	
   155	/-! ## The local widened divisor and its immediate consumer -/
   156	
   157	/- The next canonicality edge is expressed first in the localized H⁰ module.  The datum
   158	   section/native comparison needed to transport this unit to local equations is deliberately
   159	   a separate contract. -/
   160	theorem existsUnique_unit_tensorAway_rankOne_generators
   161	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   162	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   163	    (y y' : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   164	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   165	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   166	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   167	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   168	    (hy' : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   169	      (y' ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   170	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   171	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   172	    ∃! v : (Localization.Away f)ˣ,
   173	      ((1 : Localization.Away f) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y') =
   174	        (v : Localization.Away f) •
   175	          ((1 : Localization.Away f) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y) := by
   176	  let B := Localization.Away f
   177	  let Q := Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0
   178	  letI : Module.Finite P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_finite
   179	  letI : Module.Projective P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_projective
   180	  have hrankB : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
   181	      Module.rankAtStalk (B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Q) q = 1 := by
   182	    intro q
   183	    rw [Module.rankAtStalk_baseChange]
   184	    exact P.h0_rank_one (PrimeSpectrum.comap
   185	      (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier B) q)
   186	  exact Module.existsUnique_unit_smul_of_forall_tmul_ne_zero
   187	    hrankB ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y) ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y')
   188	    (AlgebraicGeometry.PicRankOneLocalPresentation.tensorAwayGenerator_fibre_ne_zero
   189	      f y hy)
   190	    (AlgebraicGeometry.PicRankOneLocalPresentation.tensorAwayGenerator_fibre_ne_zero
   191	      f y' hy')
   192	
   193	/-- The widened divisor cut by a tied rank-one section on its basic open. -/
   194	noncomputable def baseOpenRankOneDivisor
   195	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   196	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   197	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   198	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   199	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   200	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   201	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   202	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   203	    DivFamZarAff C (Localization.Away f) (genus C) :=
   204	  divFamZarAffOfFibrewiseRegularLocalEquations C (genus C)
   205	    (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy) pi
   206	    (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_fibrewiseRegular f y hy)
   207	    (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_classDeg f y hy)
   208	
   209	@[simp]
   210	theorem baseOpenRankOneDivisor_picClass
   211	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   212	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   213	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   214	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   215	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   216	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   217	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   218	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   219	    (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy).picClass =
   220	      (P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away f)).cechPicClass := by
   221	  unfold baseOpenRankOneDivisor
   222	  rw [picClass_divFamZarAffOfFibrewiseRegularLocalEquations]
   223	  exact P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_picClass f y hy
   224	
   225	/-- The Abel value of the local divisor is the restriction of the input Picard datum.  This is
   226	the immediate consumer which keeps the widened divisor tied to the chosen presentation. -/
   227	theorem baseOpenRankOneDivisor_abelAff
   228	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   229	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   230	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   231	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   232	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   233	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   234	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   235	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
